_README: Single place for links and contact. Edit, then run `node _tools/build-pages.mjs` from the repo root. Empty store URLs render a disabled 'Coming soon' button.
_legal: Jekyll pages in this repo (privacy*.md, terms*.md). Root-relative, so they follow the custom domain.
_stores: Same links on every page, with the site_badge campaign (App Store Connect > App Analytics > Campaigns; Play Console > Store performance). appStoreId feeds the iOS Smart App Banner.
_storeListings: Clean store URLs, no campaign: for the JSON-LD sameAs and llms.txt.
